description: The signer_id, receiver_id and actions of one FINAL mainnet transaction, exactly as the archival RPC tx response returned them. Every other field (public key, nonce, hash, signature, priority fee and the outcomes) is omitted; the raw response stays outside the repository because it carries the transaction signature.
located_via: NearBlocks public API GET https://api.nearblocks.io/v1/account/d4e8e706f5a59610d85924af858f0562031930d14eb7add9a433edea50cf0b03/txns, the DELETE_ACCOUNT row at block 194235831, read 2026-11-14T03:54:40Z
note: The signer and receiver is one of the five Rhea Lend worker accounts labelled incident in the label store, so receiver_labels signals on the transaction receiver as well (the beneficiary, the labelled collector account, is not a receiver the check consults); the deletes_account check is what exercises the raw DeleteAccount action.
